title: chat/send.request
description: Tauri IPC: send one user chat message to the LLM (React to Rust).

message_id.description: Client-generated id of the assistant reply placeholder; the backend reuses it so token events land on the placeholder.

session_id.description: In-memory conversation id generated by the frontend.

messages_json.description: JSON array of {role, content} prior history, excluding the new text.

text.description: The new user message to send.
